message.content:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "postgres"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-init
  namespace: wordsmith
data:
  init.sql: |
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS words (
      id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
      word VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
    );
    INSERT INTO words (word) VALUES ('hello'), ('world'), ('foo'), ('bar'), ('baz'), ('qux'), ('quux'), ('corge'), ('grault'), ('garply'), ('waldo'), ('fred'), ('plugh'), ('xyzzy'), ('thud');
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-data
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-db
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-api
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-web
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  serviceName: wordsmith-db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-db
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: wordsmith-db
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 999
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:10.0-alpine
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: initdb
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
            capabilities:
              add:
                - CHOWN
                - FOWNER
                - SETUID
                - SETGID
                - DAC_OVERRIDE
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 5432
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 5432
            failureThreshold: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 5432
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
        - name: initdb
          configMap:
            name: wordsmith-db-init
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-api
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: wordsmith-api
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-api
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              value: "postgres://postgres:postgres@wordsmith-db:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable"
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8080
            failureThreshold: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-web
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: wordsmith-web
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-web
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: API_HOST
              value: "wordsmith-api:8080"
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 128Mi
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
```
